svg.text: Reads are public (in-process + DAX cached); writes require Cognito auth and share a Redis rate-limit window. Edges show the real /v1 endpoints.
cache lives in the read svc

Dashed = not exercised end-to-end yet (CloudFront needs AWS account verification). Cache tier (DAX + ElastiCache + in-process SingleFlight) and the rate limiter are wired. AWS icons: awslabs/aws-icons-for-plantuml (Apache-2.0).
